cityStats.ownership: Own emitted geometry, far instances and material clones; borrow all station atlases, far facade textures and gradient maps. Dispose before station.
cityStats.limitation: Background only: no new physics or navigable interiors. Foundations and stairs are CPU checked; camera composition and visible CDLOD contacts need GPU acceptance.

limits: Pixel differences are full final encoded RGB, not material-isolated attribution.
Equal duplicate captures are a fixed-frame check, not walking stability.
Actual text calls and atlas crop show generated pixels; scene screenshots still require visual review.
Performance includes real baseline counting overhead and is a single run, not a causal benchmark.
